title: Weapons and Tactics Instructor (WTI) Intelligence Officer (II/ III) (LtCol to 2ndLt) and (CWO5 to WO) NMOS (0202, 0205, 0210, 2602), DIR INTEL
raw_text:
12. MOS 0277, Weapons and Tactics Instructor (WTI) Intelligence Officer (II/
III) (LtCol to 2ndLt) and (CWO5 to WO) NMOS (0202, 0205, 0210, 2602), DIR
INTEL

    a. Summary. Weapons and Tactics and Instructor (WTI) Intelligence
Officers are subject matter experts on the tactical employment of threat
weapon systems. WTI Intelligence Officers support MAGTF operations by
training Marines to develop countermeasures for adversarial aviation threats.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must possess PMOS 0202, 0205, 0210, or 2602.

        (2) Security requirement: must have a current single scope
background investigation/T5 investigation and adjudicated for sensitive
compartmented information (SCI) eligibility.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Must successfully complete the Weapons and Tactics Instructor
(WTI) Intelligence Officer Course (M140JI1), Marine Aviation Weapons and
Tactics Squadron 1, MCAS Yuma, AZ.

        (2) MOS 0277 may be awarded to both active and reserve officers as a
non-primary MOS after completing the WTI course requirements.

       d.   Duties

        (1) As the unit intelligence training officer, develop and execute
individual T&R training and collective operational unit training.

        (2) Serve as the unit SME for intelligence support to mission
planning, briefing/debriefing, threat systems and unit weapons system




                                          1-17                   Enclosure (1)
 1105                                                           NAVMC 1200.1L



employment. Be responsible for intelligence required for unit's mission in
support of the MAGTF and joint tasking.

        (3) Assist in recommending to unit commanders qualified intelligence
personnel for nominate to the WTI Course.

        (4) Instructs on current enemy capabilities and tactics to counter
the threat.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Military Enlisted Tactical Operations and Air Weapons Specialist and Crew
Members, All Other 55-3019.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
